title: Iran conflict z>1 leads DHT 1d, XLE null
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Iran conflict event 20d z-score > 1 leads DHT log returns by 1 day (+), null control: same rule on XLE should show weaker edge; trade long DHT 6d [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.DHT.log_return] (parent: R2-0004)
message: Not supported by correlation (r=-0.03, n=390, validity 0) but rubric trade rule long DHT 6d after Iran conflict z>1: 28 trades, hit 64%, avg +1.7%, OOS 8 trades hit 75%; actionability 8.69. Likely war common-cause; XLE null control queued.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long DHT next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 6 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: Iran conflict event 20d z-score > 1 leads XLE log returns by 1 day (+), expect weaker edge than DHT (hit 64%, 28 trades); trade long XLE 6d [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.XLE.log_return] (parent: R2-0104)
